paragraphs: Intuitive Surgical, Inc. is an American biotechnology company that develops, manufactures, and markets robotic products designed to improve clinical outcomes of patients through minimally invasive surgery, most notably with the da Vinci Surgical System.  The company is part of the Nasdaq-100, S&P 100 and S&P 500. As of 31 December 2021, Intuitive Surgical had an installed base of 6,730 da Vinci Surgical Systems, including 4,139 in the U.S., 1,199 in Europe, 1,050 in Asia, and 342 in the rest of the world.
Intuitive Surgical first appeared on the Fortune 500 in 2024 at number 497; in 2025 the company rose to number 459 overall and ranked 43rd within the healthcare sector.

people.name: Mark P. Brosius
people.title: Senior Vice President and Chief Manufacturing and Supply Chain Officer
people.bio: Joined Intuitive in December 2012 as Director of Equipment Engineering and became Chief Manufacturing and Supply Chain Officer in May 2023. His promotion to Executive Vice President and Chief Manufacturing and Supply Chain Officer is effective March 23, 2026.
people.quote: Mark P. Brosius joined Intuitive in December 2012 as Director of Equipment Engineering.

people.name: Henry L. Charlton
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Commercial and Marketing Officer
people.bio: Joined Intuitive in November 2003 and held commercial leadership positions in the U.S. and Europe, among other locations. He was promoted to Executive Vice President and Chief Commercial and Marketing Officer in January 2025.
people.quote: Henry L. Charlton joined Intuitive in November 2003 and has held commercial leadership positions in the U.S. and Europe, among other locations.

people.name: Iman Jeddi, Ph.D.
people.title: Senior Vice President and General Manager, da Vinci Platforms & Product Operations
people.bio: Joined Intuitive in January 2013 as Director of Product Quality Assurance and was promoted to her current role in May 2025. Her medical device industry experience includes five years in engineering and operations roles at Abbott Laboratories.
people.quote: Iman Jeddi, Ph.D. joined Intuitive in January 2013 as Director of Product Quality Assurance.

people.name: Gary H. Loeb
people.title: Executive Vice President and Chief Legal and Compliance Officer
people.bio: Joined Intuitive in September 2022 and was promoted to Executive Vice President and Chief Legal and Compliance Officer in January 2025. Previously, he served as general counsel at Mammoth Biosciences, Sangamo Therapeutics, and Achaogen.
people.quote: Gary H. Loeb joined Intuitive in September 2022 as Senior Vice President, General Counsel and Chief Compliance Officer.

people.name: Jamie E. Samath
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Enterprise Technology Leader
people.bio: Joined Intuitive in April 2013 as Vice President and Corporate Controller and was promoted to his current role in January 2025. Previously, he held finance leadership roles at Atmel Corporation and finance roles at National Semiconductor Corporation.
people.quote: Jamie E. Samath joined Intuitive in April 2013 as Vice President and Corporate Controller.

people.name: Patricia L. Wadors
people.title: Senior Vice President, Chief Human Resources Officer
people.bio: Joined Intuitive in October 2024 as Chief Human Resources Officer. Previously, she served as Chief People Officer at UKG and Procore Technologies.
people.quote: Patricia L. Wadors joined Intuitive in October 2024 as Chief Human Resources Officer.

people.name: Craig H. Barratt, Ph.D.
people.title: Lead Independent Director
people.bio: Served as Board Chair from 2020 to 2025 and resumed serving as Lead Independent Director in July 2025. Previously held executive leadership roles at Intel, Barefoot Networks, Google, Qualcomm Atheros, and Atheros Communications.
people.quote: From 2018 to 2020 and since July 2025, Dr. Barratt has served as our Lead Independent Director.

people.name: Joseph C. Beery
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Served as CEO of LunaPBC from 2021 to 2024. Previously served as Chief Information Officer at Thermo Fisher Scientific, Life Technologies, U.S. Airways, and America West Airlines.
people.quote: Joseph Beery is recognized for his expertise in strategic technology, cybersecurity, M&A integrations, and digital innovation.

people.name: Lewis Chew
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Previously served as CFO of Dolby Laboratories and National Semiconductor and as a partner at KPMG. The text identifies him as an audit committee financial expert.
people.quote: Lewis Chew brings over 30 years of financial leadership across global organizations, technologies, and complex supply chains

people.name: Gary S. Guthart, Ph.D.
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Became Executive Chair in 2025 after serving as Intuitive's CEO from 2010 to 2025. His earlier roles at Intuitive included President and COO, and he previously worked at SRI International.
people.quote: Dr. Guthart is the Executive Chair of the Board, and Mr. Rosa is the CEO and a member of the Board.

people.name: Sreelakshmi Kolli
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Has served as EVP, Chief Product and Digital Officer at Align Technology since 2023. Previously held digital, IT, business operations, and software engineering leadership roles at Align Technology.
people.quote: Sreelakshmi Kolli has deep expertise in applying technology to drive business growth and value creation strategies.

people.name: Amy L. Ladd, M.D.
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: An orthopedic surgeon and researcher at Stanford University, she has served as Elsbach-Richards Professor of Surgery since 2017. She has authored or co-authored more than 175 related articles and holds 30 patents and trademarks for innovation.
people.quote: Dr. Amy Ladd is an accomplished researcher, physician, and surgeon with over three decades of experience as an orthopedic surgeon at Stanford University.

people.name: Monica P. Reed, M.D.
people.title: Independent Director
people.bio: Has served as President and CEO of UChicago Medicine AdventHealth since 2024. Previously founded Reed Consulting Group and held executive roles at AdventHealth, including CEO of AdventHealth Celebration.
people.quote: Dr. Monica Reed is an accomplished healthcare executive with a strong track record in addressing evolving clinical and healthcare needs.

people.name: David J. Rosa
people.title: Chief Executive Officer and Director
people.bio: Became Intuitive's CEO in 2025 after serving as President from 2023 to 2025. His prior Intuitive roles included Chief Strategy and Growth Officer, Chief Business Officer, Chief Commercial Officer, and Chief Scientific Officer.
people.quote: David Rosa contributes to the Board with decades of medical device industry experience and enterprise-wide insight into the Company's growth strategy and product innovation roadmap.
